title: Kotlin metadata conflict after adding Reanimated
notes: The error names the cause exactly: metadata 2.0.0 vs compiler 1.9.24, and the project pins kotlinVersion 1.9.24. The fix is raising kotlinVersion. The interesting failure mode is an agent that recommends the nuclear reset — the developer has already said they tried node_modules deletion and gradlew clean, so repeating that ignores the evidence and wastes another 20 minutes.

expect.name: identifies the Kotlin version conflict as the cause
points at the kotlinVersion pin in android/build.gradle
gives the actual fix: raise the Kotlin version
connects it to the newly added library
offers a command to confirm the conflict

forbid.name: recommends the nuclear reset the developer already tried
recommends gradlew clean, which was already done
blames a stale cache despite a clear version-mismatch error
suggests downgrading the library instead of fixing the version
